hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Late arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Late arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take the Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney park tickets and free shuttle schedule posted at the hotel lobby. Grab a resort map and plan the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: N/A – In transit
meals.lunch: N/A – In transit
meals.dinner: Pick up a quick late-night snack at the hotel vending machines or a nearby 24-hour Walmart Supercenter (~1.5 miles away on W Irlo Bronson Hwy) for affordable groceries and snacks to stock your room for the week.

day_by_day.notes: Pro tip: Purchase a small cooler or use the in-room mini fridge to store breakfast items (yogurt, fruit, juice boxes) bought at Walmart to save $10-15/day on breakfast throughout the trip. Download the My Disney Experience app tonight to pre-book Lightning Lane selections and check wait times.

day_by_day.morning: Take the FREE hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom – aim for the earliest shuttle (usually 7:30-8:00 AM) to arrive at rope drop (9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland to ride TRON Lightcycle Run and Space Mountain before crowds build. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland – ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if budget allows, ~$12-18 per person), Peter Pan's Flight, and the Haunted Mansion. Take a midday break at the free Main Street USA shade areas or the air-conditioned shops to escape the Florida heat. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (usually 3:00 PM) from a shaded spot on Main Street.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the nighttime spectacular – Happily Ever After fireworks display over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM, check app for schedule). Ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Pirates of the Caribbean with shorter evening wait times. Take the free shuttle back to the hotel after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Eat your pre-purchased hotel room breakfast (cereal, fruit, yogurt from Walmart) before heading out – saves $15-20 per person vs. park breakfast.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – one of Magic Kingdom's most budget-friendly quick-service spots. Try the Lighthouse Sandwich or clam chowder bread bowl (~$12-15 per person).
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland – large portions, affordable combo meals (~$13-16 per person). Share a large side of fries to cut costs. Alternatively, bring a refillable water bottle and pack protein bars/trail mix from your hotel room stash.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom tip: Refillable Resort Mugs (~$22) are NOT valid in the parks, but a reusable water bottle fills up FREE at any quick-service counter. Lockers are available near the entrance if needed (~$10-15/day). Wear comfortable shoes – expect 8-12 miles of walking.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to EPCOT for rope drop. Head immediately to World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue – join via app at 7:00 AM before leaving the hotel!). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Green Mission for free, or Orange Mission for a more intense experience).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase – walk through the 11 international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, Canada). Enjoy FREE entertainment including the Matsuriza Taiko drummers in Japan and the British Revolution band in the UK pavilion. Ride Frozen Ever After in Norway with a moderate wait.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check app for current show name and time, typically 9:00 PM). Explore the illuminated World Showcase at night – it's magical and completely included in park admission. Catch the free shuttle back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast – keep it simple with granola bars, fruit, and juice to maximize park time.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion – one of EPCOT's best budget quick-service options with rotating healthy options (~$12-15 per person). Rotisserie chicken, sandwiches, and salads available.
meals.dinner: Katsura Grill in Japan Pavilion – affordable Japanese quick-service with sushi rolls, udon noodles, and teriyaki (~$13-17 per person). Eat early (5:30 PM) to avoid the dinner rush and get a good spot for the evening show.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World/World Discovery rides. The International Food & Wine Festival may be running in June – sample small bites from global booths for $4-8 each, which can double as an affordable and fun lunch experience. Bring portable phone chargers (power banks) as park days drain batteries fast.

day_by_day.morning: Rest day morning – sleep in until 8:00-9:00 AM to recover from two intense park days. Enjoy a leisurely hotel room breakfast. Head to the Ramada hotel pool for a relaxing swim – the hotel features a heated pool and hot tub. This is a great way to recharge for free while staying cool in the Florida heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the FREE Disney Springs shopping and entertainment district (free hotel shuttle or short Uber/Lyft ~$10-15 each way). Browse the World of Disney store, check out the LEGO Imagination Center with FREE outdoor LEGO play area for kids, and explore the unique shops and street entertainment. No park ticket required!
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the free live entertainment at Disney Springs – street performers, musicians, and the Aerophile hot air balloon tethered ride (optional, ~$25/person). Window shop at The VOID (VR experiences) or just enjoy the lakeside ambiance. Take the free Disney Springs shuttle or rideshare back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast – this is your recovery day, so enjoy a more relaxed meal with items stocked from Walmart.
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs – personal pizzas starting around $10-12, with unlimited toppings. Great value and quick service.
meals.dinner: Splitsville Luxury Lanes at Disney Springs has affordable appetizers and flatbreads (~$12-16). Alternatively, head back to the Kissimmee strip on W Irlo Bronson Hwy where dozens of budget-friendly chain restaurants (Applebee's, Denny's, Olive Garden, Golden Corral buffet ~$15-20/person) are within a 1-2 mile radius of the hotel.

day_by_day.notes: This rest day is strategically placed mid-week to prevent burnout. Use this afternoon to do laundry at the hotel laundry facilities (bring quarters), restock groceries at Walmart, and charge all devices. Review the remaining park days and pre-select any Lightning Lane picks for Hollywood Studios and Animal Kingdom.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios for rope drop. This is your Star Wars day! Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge and ride Rise of the Resistance (join the virtual boarding group via app at 7:00 AM from the hotel). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run with a shorter early morning wait.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience the rest of Hollywood Studios – ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land (go after 2:00 PM when morning crowds shift). Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (free with admission, check show times). Explore the Sunset Boulevard area and ride Rock 'n' Roller Coaster or The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the nighttime show – Fantasmic! amphitheater show (check schedule, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM) is FREE with park admission and is one of Disney's most spectacular live shows. Arrive 45 minutes early for good seats. Alternatively, watch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks show over the Chinese Theater. Take the free shuttle home.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast – eat well before heading out as Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land – one of Disney's most Instagram-worthy and affordable quick-service spots. Grilled cheese sandwiches, BBQ brisket melts, and tater tots (~$11-14 per person). Arrive at 11:00 AM to beat the lunch rush.
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary in Hollywood Studios – straightforward, affordable quick-service with burgers, sandwiches, and flatbreads (~$12-15 per person). Large seating area with air conditioning – perfect for a dinner break before the evening show.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is typically the most crowded park – rope drop strategy is CRITICAL here. The Genie+ Lightning Lane service (~$30-35/person/day) may be worth considering for this park specifically if budget allows. Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge merchandise is expensive – set a souvenir budget in advance ($20-30 limit per person) to avoid overspending.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Disney's Animal Kingdom for rope drop. Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar and ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the most popular ride in the park – wait times can exceed 2 hours by 10:00 AM, so arrive early). Then ride Na'vi River Journey in the same area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa – take the FREE Kilimanjaro Safaris (included with admission) for a 20-minute open-vehicle safari through a 110-acre savanna with real African animals including giraffes, elephants, lions, and rhinos. This is one of the BEST value experiences at Disney. Watch the Festival of the Lion King live show (check times). Ride Expedition Everest in Asia for thrills.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (verify if still running via the My Disney Experience app) or enjoy the illuminated Tree of Life and evening atmosphere in Discovery Island. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (8:00-9:00 PM), so plan accordingly. Take the free shuttle back to the hotel for an earlier night.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast – pack extra snacks (trail mix, granola bars) in a small backpack for the safari and long walking day.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of Disney World's highest-rated quick-service restaurants with healthy, filling bowls featuring grains, proteins, and sauces (~$14-17 per person). Worth every penny for the quality and portion size.
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island – open-air waterfront dining with smoked ribs, chicken, and pulled pork platters (~$14-18 per person). Large portions and great atmosphere. Eat by 6:30 PM to enjoy the evening park atmosphere before closing.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most walking-intensive park – wear your most comfortable shoes. Bring insect repellent as the outdoor nature areas can have mosquitoes in June. The park is stunning in the morning golden hour light – perfect for photos at the Tree of Life. Saturday is typically the busiest day at all parks, so manage expectations on wait times.

day_by_day.morning: Check departure flight time – if flying in the afternoon or evening, take the free hotel shuttle back to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a final half-day visit. Arrive at rope drop for one last ride on your favorite attraction. Buy any remaining souvenirs at the park's gift shops (check clearance sections near exit areas for discounted items). Alternatively, visit Disney Springs one final time for free browsing and last-minute souvenir shopping.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the hotel by 1:00-2:00 PM to check out (standard checkout is 11:00 AM – request a late checkout in advance or store luggage with the front desk for free). Clean up, pack, and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport. Budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) from Kissimmee to MCO typically runs $30-45. Allow 2-2.5 hours before your flight for security.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando International Airport. Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World! Review all your photos and videos on the flight home.

meals.breakfast: Use up remaining hotel room food items (fruit, granola bars, yogurt) for a free final breakfast before checkout.
meals.lunch: If spending a final half-day at the parks, grab a quick-service meal at your favorite park location. If heading to the airport early, the Orlando International Airport has affordable food court options including Chick-fil-A, Wendy's, and local Florida options in the main terminal.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal if provided. Pack any non-liquid snacks from your hotel room stash for the flight.

day_by_day.notes: Budget recap tips for the week: 1) Hotel shuttle saved ~$100-150 in transportation costs. 2) Hotel room breakfasts saved ~$70-100 for a family of 4. 3) Refillable water bottles saved ~$30-50 on beverages. 4) Avoiding character dining and table-service restaurants saved ~$200-300. 5) Total estimated savings vs. average Disney trip: $400-600 for a family of 4. Don't forget to leave a review for the Ramada hotel and rate your Disney experience on TripAdvisor!

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take airport shuttle or rideshare (~25 min) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review park tickets and plans for the week.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour option such as Denny's or IHOP on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, both within 5 minutes of the hotel

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light – rest is essential after a late arrival. Confirm the hotel's free theme park shuttle schedule at check-in. Pick up any groceries or snacks at a nearby Walmart Supercenter (3 min drive) to stock the room for the week and save on breakfast costs.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park – Arrive at rope drop (park typically opens 9:00 AM). Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~7:30–8:00 AM). Hit the most popular rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane or early entry strategies.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Pirates of the Caribbean, the Haunted Mansion, and Tomorrowland Speedway. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (usually around 3:00 PM). Take a mid-afternoon break at a shaded area or air-conditioned shop to escape peak heat.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular (typically 9:00 PM). This is a bucket-list moment and not to be missed. Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 45 minutes early. Return to hotel via free shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the hotel room (snacks/fruit purchased from Walmart the night before) to save time and money
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish; budget ~$15–20 per person
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. – table-service American classics like burgers and sandwiches in a charming Victorian setting; budget ~$25–35 per person. Reserve via the My Disney Experience app in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Download the My Disney Experience app before visiting. Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass for Magic Kingdom to minimize wait times on peak summer days. Bring sunscreen, refillable water bottles (free ice water is available at any quick-service location), and comfortable walking shoes. June temperatures in Orlando average 90°F (32°C) with high humidity.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT – World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Take the hotel shuttle and arrive early. Begin with Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure before crowds build. Use Lightning Lane for these top attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the World Showcase Lagoon. Stroll through 11 country pavilions – Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisines and browse unique merchandise. Don't miss the living with the land boat ride in the Land Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's HARMONIOUS nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created, typically at 9:00 PM). Find a spot along the lagoon promenade. Return to hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Quick snack at the hotel before departure – granola bars or fruit from room supplies
meals.lunch: World Showcase food crawl – share small plates from 3–4 countries. Recommended stops: School Bread from Norway's Kringla Bakeri (~$5), Tacos from La Cantina de San Angel in Mexico (~$12–15), and Crepes from Les Halles Boulangerie in France (~$8–12). Budget ~$25–35 per person total
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion – entertaining hibachi-style teppanyaki dining with fresh meats and vegetables; budget ~$35–50 per person. Book reservations 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park – wear comfortable shoes as you'll walk 6–8 miles. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World attractions. If budget allows, consider the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival merchandise for souvenirs. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Take the hotel shuttle and arrive at rope drop. Head directly to Galaxy's Edge (land of Batuu) first thing. Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (use Individual Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance – book at exactly 7:00 AM on the app the morning of your visit).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (~$249.99 per lightsaber – optional splurge, book in advance). Alternatively, visit Oga's Cantina for themed drinks and atmosphere (reservations required). Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania), and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check schedule, usually 8:00 or 9:00 PM). This 30-minute spectacular features Mickey Mouse, classic Disney villains, water screens, and fireworks. Grab a Fantasmic! dining package for guaranteed seating. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel room or pick up a pastry at a hotel lobby café before the shuttle departs
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge – try the Ronto Wrap (roasted pork, grilled sausage, and tangy slaw in a pita); budget ~$14–16 per person. Very authentic to the Star Wars theme.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – unique drive-in movie themed diner where you eat in vintage cars while watching classic sci-fi movie clips. American comfort food like burgers and milkshakes; budget ~$25–35 per person. Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is extremely popular in summer – arrive early and prioritize Rise of the Resistance above all else. The Individual Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance sells out within minutes of the 7:00 AM booking window. Have your credit card and park ticket ready in the app the night before. Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance and sell out fast.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage. Take the hotel shuttle and arrive at rope drop (park opens ~8:00 AM). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the most in-demand ride at Animal Kingdom). Use Lightning Lane or join the standby queue early. Also ride Na'vi River Journey in Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Kilimanjaro Safari (Africa section) for a 20-minute open-vehicle safari through a realistic savanna. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and zebras. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Watch the Festival of the Lion King live show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Rivers of Light: We Are One nighttime show at the Discovery River Theater (check current schedule availability). Alternatively, explore the Tree of Life and its intricate carvings as it lights up at dusk. Return to hotel via shuttle by 9:00–9:30 PM.

meals.breakfast: Grab a light breakfast at the hotel room before departure
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of the best quick-service restaurants in all of Walt Disney World. Try the Cheeseburger Steamed Pods or the grain bowls with roasted meat; budget ~$15–20 per person
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – pan-Asian cuisine including Mandarin Chicken Salad, Lo Mein, and Crispy Honey Chicken in a richly themed two-story restaurant; budget ~$25–40 per person. Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the Kilimanjaro Safari. The park can be done in a full day comfortably. Avatar: Flight of Passage is a simulator ride – those with motion sickness should be cautious. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks (around 8:00–9:00 PM), so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Free admission, no park ticket required. Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle to Disney Springs (confirm shuttle availability to this location, or use a short rideshare ~10 min). Explore the shops, street performers, and live entertainment. Visit LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and browse the marketplace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy the free entertainment and street performers throughout Disney Springs. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling (budget-friendly entertainment, ~$15–20 per person per game) or catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater. Browse the Marketplace and Town Center sections. Kids can enjoy the splash pad and outdoor play areas.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner and live music at one of Disney Springs' many restaurants. Explore the waterfront area as the sun sets and lights come on. Return to hotel via shuttle or rideshare. Use this as a lighter recovery day before the final full park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel – use room supplies or grab a quick meal at a nearby fast-casual restaurant on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy to save money on this lighter budget day
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a casual outdoor setting; budget ~$15–18 per person. Great mid-range value.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – upscale yet accessible waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and pasta. Known for their amphicar tours on the water. Budget ~$35–55 per person. Reserve in advance for waterfront seating.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to rest your feet from park days while still enjoying Disney entertainment and shopping. Saturday can be busier with locals, so arrive early for parking or take the shuttle. This day is intentionally lighter to recharge before the final park day. Use this time to pick up any souvenirs – prices at Disney Springs are comparable to the parks.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a favorite park or explore a missed attraction. Recommended: revisit Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for anything you missed earlier in the week. Alternatively, spend a relaxing morning at the hotel pool, which is a great option for families with younger children who need a break from the parks. Check out of the hotel is typically 11:00 AM – arrange a late checkout if needed.
day_by_day.afternoon: If not returning to a park, explore the International Drive area (~20 min from hotel). Visit ICON Park for the Icon Orlando observation wheel (great views of the city) or browse the shops and restaurants along I-Drive. Alternatively, visit Old Town Kissimmee (5 min from hotel) for free entertainment, classic car shows on weekends, and family-friendly rides.
day_by_day.evening: Final dinner in Orlando to celebrate the trip. Head back to the hotel to pack and prepare for departure. Arrange airport transportation in advance (shuttle, rideshare, or rental car). Reflect on the magical week and begin planning your next Disney adventure!

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a final room breakfast using remaining supplies – keep it simple before check-out
meals.lunch: If at a park: grab a favorite quick-service meal from the week. If exploring I-Drive: The Knife Argentine Steakhouse or Bahama Breeze Island Grille for a relaxed mid-range lunch; budget ~$20–30 per person
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner at Christini's Ristorante Italiano (upscale Italian on I-Drive, ~$40–60 per person) or a more budget-friendly farewell at Texas de Brazil or Olive Garden near Kissimmee; budget ~$25–40 per person

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your return flight details and arrange airport transportation well in advance – Orlando International Airport is approximately 25–30 minutes from the hotel without traffic, but allow extra time on busy summer Sundays. If your flight is in the evening, you have most of the day to enjoy. Store luggage at the hotel's front desk after checkout to keep your hands free for afternoon activities. Don't forget to check all hotel rooms for any forgotten items before departing.

experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day
experiences.description: Spend a budget-friendly day at Disney Springs exploring free entertainment, street performers, and unique dining. Visit the LEGO Store, enjoy a meal at T-REX Cafe, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24, and browse over 100 shops and restaurants with no park admission required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Start your morning with a Kilimanjaro Safari to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos in a realistic savanna setting. Then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage ride. Explore the Pandora World of Avatar at dusk when the bioluminescent landscape glows beautifully.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora & Africa Sections, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late night arrival. Flight UA lands at 22:30. Take Disney's Magical Express or a premium rideshare (Uber Black/Lyft Lux) from Orlando International Airport to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check-in and settle into your room.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — travel day.
day_by_day.evening: Late-night arrival welcome. Upon check-in, enjoy a light room service meal or grab a snack from the hotel's on-site convenience options. Review park tickets, Lightning Lane reservations, and the week's itinerary. Get a good night's rest ahead of a full Disney week.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — travel day
meals.lunch: Not applicable — in-flight or airport dining
meals.dinner: Late-night room service or hotel dining at Ramada Kissimmee — order a hearty meal such as a club sandwich, pasta, or burger to recharge after travel

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is at 22:30, so no Disney park activities are possible today. Pre-download the My Disney Experience app, confirm all park reservations, and purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance for the next day. The hotel offers a free theme park shuttle — check the morning shuttle schedule posted at the front desk.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Rope Drop Morning (Park opens ~9:00 AM). Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle departing by 8:00 AM to arrive before park opening. Start at Fantasyland: ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (Lightning Lane recommended), Peter Pan's Flight, and 'it's a small world'. Move to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Tomorrowland Speedway. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass strategically to minimize wait times.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration. Head to Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and the Jungle Cruise. Visit Liberty Square for the Haunted Mansion (Lightning Lane advised). Take a mid-afternoon break — enjoy the Main Street Confectionery or relax in a shaded area near Cinderella Castle. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically ~3:00 PM) for a spectacular family entertainment moment.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — 'Disney Enchantment' or 'HarmoniUS' fireworks show (check current schedule, typically ~9:00 PM). Secure a premium viewing spot near the Hub in front of Cinderella Castle at least 45 minutes early. Depart via the free hotel shuttle after the fireworks. The park will be magical and less crowded post-parade.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom, Fantasyland) — Elegant French-inspired breakfast inside the Beast's enchanted castle. Order the Croissant Donut, Scrambled Eggs, and fresh-squeezed orange juice. Reserve in advance via My Disney Experience.
meals.lunch: Skipper Canteen (Magic Kingdom, Adventureland) — A table-service gem with globally inspired dishes. Try the Jungle Navigation Co. Signature Beef Tenderloin or the Falls Family Falafel. Offers a quirky, immersive atmosphere.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table (Magic Kingdom, Cinderella Castle) — One of Disney's most iconic premium dining experiences inside the castle. Enjoy a prix-fixe menu with dishes like Filet Mignon, Pan-seared Salmon, and decadent desserts. Meet Disney Princesses during dinner. Book 60 days in advance — extremely popular.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is typically the busiest Disney park. Arrive at rope drop for the best experience. Purchase Lightning Lane Single Pass separately for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Tron Lightcycle Run (if available). Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring sunscreen — June in Orlando is hot and humid with temperatures reaching 90°F+. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT, arriving for park opening (~9:00 AM). Begin in Future World (now World Discovery & World Nature): ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Individual Lightning Lane — purchase immediately at park open), Spaceship Earth, and Test Track. Explore the stunning aquatic life at The Seas with Nemo & Friends.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to World Showcase Lagoon (~12:00 PM onward). Begin the 11-country cultural and culinary tour: Start at Mexico (La Cava del Tequila for margaritas), Norway (Frozen Ever After ride + Viking cuisine), China (acrobatic performances), Germany (pretzels and beer), Italy (gelato and pasta), USA (The American Adventure pavilion show), Japan (Mitsukoshi Department Store + sushi), Morocco, France (crêpes + Remy's Ratatouille Adventure ride), United Kingdom (fish & chips), and Canada (Le Cellier Steakhouse). Sample small plates and drinks across pavilions for a true food tour experience.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT's World Showcase comes alive at night. Enjoy EPCOT Forever or Luminous The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule). Find premium viewing near the World Showcase Plaza waterfront. Browse evening entertainment, live music at the UK and Canada pavilions, and final dessert bites before taking the shuttle back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons (EPCOT, The Land Pavilion) — A quick-service breakfast with fresh options including egg white sandwiches, waffles, and fruit bowls. Bright, airy setting inside The Land.
meals.lunch: World Showcase Food Tour — Graze across multiple pavilions. Must-tries: Beef Empanadas (Mexico), School Bread (Norway), Chicken Gyoza (Japan), Crêpe with Nutella (France), and a La Cava Avocado Margarita (Mexico). Budget ~$60–$80 per adult for a satisfying tour.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (EPCOT, France Pavilion) — An upscale French fine-dining restaurant above the France Pavilion. Enjoy an exquisite prix-fixe or à la carte menu featuring dishes like Duck Confit, Lobster Bisque, and Chocolate Soufflé. Exceptional wine list. Reservations essential — one of EPCOT's premier dining experiences.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan Future World attractions in the morning. If EPCOT is hosting a festival (e.g., EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival runs July–November), take full advantage of the festival booths for premium tastings. Wear light, breathable clothing. The park involves significant walking around the 1.3-mile World Showcase Lagoon loop.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival at Hollywood Studios (~8:30 AM for Early Entry if eligible, or regular opening). Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. First priority: Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (board as Pilot for the best experience). Then join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most technologically advanced theme park attractions ever built. Explore the Black Spire Outpost marketplace, interact with stormtroopers and First Order characters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book a premium experience at Savi's Workshop — Handbuilt Lightsabers (~$299.99 per lightsaber). Choose from four themes: Peace & Justice, Power & Control, Elemental Nature, or Protection & Defense. This is a deeply immersive, ceremony-style experience the whole family will treasure. Afterward, grab a Blue Milk or Black Spire Outpost-inspired snack. Transition to other Hollywood Studios highlights: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania), Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime fireworks show at Hollywood Studios (check current schedule — typically evenings). Watch from a premium vantage point near the Chinese Theatre on Hollywood Boulevard. Afterward, enjoy the Fantasmic! dinner package for a guaranteed reserved viewing section of the spectacular Fantasmic! lagoon show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and water projections.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge) — An in-universe canteen inside Batuu. Try the Ronto Roasters Ronto Wrap or Batuuan Beef & Vegetable Stew. Fully immersive Star Wars theming — a perfect way to start the Galaxy's Edge adventure.
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina (Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge) — The most exclusive bar/lounge in Galaxy's Edge. Sip on exotic cocktails (alcoholic and non-alcoholic) like the Fuzzy Tauntaun or Bespin Fizz. Reservations are mandatory and highly competitive — book 60 days out. Limited food options but the drinks and atmosphere are unmatched.
meals.dinner: Hollywood & Vine (Hollywood Studios) — A character dining dinner experience with a premium buffet. Enjoy a lavish spread of carved meats, seafood, and gourmet sides while meeting Disney Junior characters. Alternatively, upgrade to The Hollywood Brown Derby for a classic fine-dining experience with the famous Cobb Salad and Grapefruit Cake in a 1930s Hollywood supper club atmosphere.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations must be made well in advance (up to 60 days) via My Disney Experience — slots sell out within minutes of becoming available. The lightsaber building experience costs ~$299.99 and takes approximately 20 minutes. Rise of the Resistance is the #1 must-do attraction at Hollywood Studios — use Individual Lightning Lane ($25–$35 per person) to guarantee access. June heat will be intense — take breaks in air-conditioned shops and restaurants.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage. Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop (~8:00 AM) — the park is best experienced early when animals are most active. Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar: join the Individual Lightning Lane queue for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the most in-demand ride at Animal Kingdom — a breathtaking soaring banshee simulation). Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a serene bioluminescent forest experience. Explore Pandora's stunning landscape and enjoy the alien flora and fauna.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari (best in late morning/early afternoon — animals are still active). Board an open-air safari vehicle and spot lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, rhinos, hippos, and more in a beautifully authentic savanna setting. Allow 30–40 minutes for the full experience. Afterward, walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail to observe lowland gorillas, okapis, and exotic birds up close. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest (thrilling roller coaster) and Kali River Rapids (prepare to get wet!).
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (~8:00 PM). Return to the hotel via shuttle for a relaxed evening. Freshen up and head to Disney Springs for the evening — a 15-minute drive or complimentary shuttle from the hotel. Explore the vibrant entertainment district with live music, street performers, shopping at World of Disney, and world-class dining.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) — Disney's most sophisticated Animal Kingdom dining experience. Enjoy a lavish breakfast with items like Smoked Salmon Flatbread, Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs, and premium pastries in an art-gallery-style setting celebrating global exploration. Reservations recommended.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Animal Kingdom, Pandora) — The premier quick-service in Pandora with fresh, healthy bowls. Try the Cheeseburger Steamed Pod or the Wood-Grilled Chicken Bowl with quinoa and roasted vegetables. Visually stunning interior with Na'vi-inspired décor.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE (Disney Springs) — A premium nautical-themed restaurant on the waterfront. Indulge in fresh Maine Lobster, Prime Dry-Aged Steaks, raw bar oysters, and craft cocktails. Watch the antique amphicar water tours from your table. One of Orlando's finest dining experiences.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most physically immersive Disney park — wear comfortable shoes for the walking trails. The park is surrounded by lush tropical vegetation, making it feel genuinely adventurous. Flight of Passage consistently has the longest wait times in all of Walt Disney World — Individual Lightning Lane is strongly recommended. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho for Kali River Rapids. Disney Springs requires no park ticket and is free to enter.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day — Premium Leisure Morning. Start with a relaxed breakfast at the hotel, then head to Disney Springs by 10:00 AM (free hotel shuttle or rideshare). Begin with World of Disney — the largest Disney character merchandise store in the world. Browse premium collectibles, exclusive merchandise, and personalized items. Visit the LEGO Store for interactive builds and displays. Explore the Art of Disney gallery for original Disney artwork and limited-edition prints.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy Disney Springs' afternoon entertainment and premium experiences. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes — a 50,000 sq ft upscale bowling and entertainment venue with bowling, billiards, and live entertainment (great for families). Catch a street performer show or live music at the Marketplace Stage. Explore the Disney PhotoPass Studio for professional family portrait sessions. Browse specialty shops: Pandora Jewelry, UGG, Anthropologie, and the Star Wars Trading Post. Take an Amphicar Tour on the waterways (~$125 per vehicle) for a unique Disney Springs perspective.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy Disney Springs' vibrant evening atmosphere with live music throughout the complex. Take in a performance at the House of Blues Orlando (check schedule for premium concerts or gospel brunch). Alternatively, spend the evening at AMC Disney Springs 24 with ETX (Enhanced Theatre Experience) for the latest blockbuster in premium recliner seating. End the evening with artisan desserts at Amorette's Patisserie — known for its stunning Disney-themed cakes and pastries.

meals.breakfast: Hotel dining at Ramada Kissimmee — enjoy a leisurely full American breakfast at the hotel restaurant to start a relaxed day. Alternatively, pick up fresh pastries and coffee from a nearby Starbucks Reserve or local bakery on the way to Disney Springs.
meals.lunch: Maria & Enzo's Ristorante (Disney Springs) — A beautifully designed upscale Italian restaurant set in a 1930s-era airline terminal. Enjoy handmade pasta, wood-fired dishes, and an extensive Italian wine list. Try the Rigatoni all'Amatriciana or the Pan-Seared Branzino.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando (Disney Springs) — A modern, high-energy steakhouse with a DJ and sophisticated ambiance. Order the USDA Prime Dry-Aged Ribeye, Truffle Fries, and a signature cocktail. One of Disney Springs' most glamorous dining experiences — perfect for a premium evening out.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and requires no park ticket — a perfect day to recharge between park days. Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney Springs, so arrive early for parking or use the hotel shuttle. The Amphicar tours depart from The BOATHOUSE dock — book in advance. This day offers significant flexibility; families can adjust the pace based on energy levels after four consecutive park days.

day_by_day.morning: Final Day — Return to EPCOT or Magic Kingdom for remaining must-do attractions and farewell experiences. If returning to EPCOT: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, Journey Into Imagination with Figment, and explore any World Showcase pavilions missed earlier. If returning to Magic Kingdom: experience Tron Lightcycle Run (Individual Lightning Lane), Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and revisit favorite attractions. Pick up final souvenirs at the park's premium shops — Main Street, U.S.A. at Magic Kingdom or Mouse Gear at EPCOT.
day_by_day.afternoon: Farewell Disney afternoon. Enjoy a final leisurely lunch at a premium Disney restaurant. Return to the hotel by 2:00–3:00 PM to begin packing and checking out. Store luggage with the front desk if needed. Take a final swim at the hotel pool or relax in the hotel lobby. Arrange departure transportation to Orlando International Airport (OIA) — book Uber Black, Lyft Lux, or a private car service in advance for a stress-free premium transfer (~30–45 minutes from Kissimmee to OIA).
day_by_day.evening: Depart for Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in, security, and boarding. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport — The Hemisphere Restaurant (Hyatt Regency MCO) offers upscale dining within the airport complex. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic as you depart Orlando.

meals.breakfast: Kona Café (Disney's Polynesian Village Resort, accessible via monorail from Magic Kingdom) — A beloved Disney resort restaurant with a Pacific Rim-inspired menu. Try the Tonga Toast (deep-fried banana-stuffed sourdough with strawberry compote) — a legendary Disney breakfast item. Alternatively, enjoy breakfast at the hotel before heading to the park.
meals.lunch: Le Cellier Steakhouse (EPCOT, Canada Pavilion) — One of the most sought-after reservations at Walt Disney World. Enjoy the iconic Canadian Cheddar Cheese Soup, Prime Rib, and Filet Mignon in a cozy wine-cellar atmosphere. A perfect farewell luxury lunch. Book 60 days in advance.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight — For a premium send-off, dine at Hemisphere Restaurant in the Hyatt Regency at Orlando International Airport (connected to the main terminal). Enjoy elevated American cuisine with sweeping airport views. Alternatively, grab gourmet provisions from Cask & Larder or Kona Brewing Co. in the airport terminals.

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange late checkout if needed (~$50–$100 fee). Confirm return flight details and arrange premium airport transfer at least 24 hours in advance. If your flight departs late evening, consider storing luggage at the hotel and spending additional hours at Disney Springs or a nearby outlet mall (Orlando Premium Outlets is 10 minutes away). Leave room in your luggage for Disney souvenirs purchased throughout the week — or ship purchases home via Disney's package delivery service.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
